description_en: Queries the details of the stack instances associated with a specified stack group in an Alibaba Cloud region
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组关联的资源栈实例列表详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-stack-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStackInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the stack group. The name must be unique within a region.   
The name can be up to 255 characters in length, and must start with a digit or a letter. It can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。名称在单个地域内唯一。   
长度不超过255个字符，必须以数字或英文字母开头，可以包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: stack_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the execution account to which the stack belongs.

In the self-managed permissions pattern, the account is an Alibaba Cloud account.

In the service-managed permissions pattern, the account is one of the member accounts of a resource folder.
For more information about execution accounts, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈所属目标账号ID。

自助管理权限模式下，该账号是阿里云账号。

服务管理权限模式下，该账号是资源目录的成员账号。
关于目标账号的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html
parameters.name: stack_instance_account_id

parameters.help_en: The region to which the stack belongs
parameters.name: stack_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query.  

Valid values: 1 to 50.
  
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。  

取值范围：1~50。
  
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the page number during paging in a paged query.  

Starting value: 1.
  
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的页码。  

起始值：1。
  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: Settings for the page number during paging in a paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码

PageSize.description_en: Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the execution account to which the stack instance belongs

DriftDetectionTime.description_en:
The time when the last successful drift detection was performed on the stack instance. The time is displayed in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format.

This parameter is returned only when drift detection has been performed on the stack group
DriftDetectionTime.description_zh:
资源栈最近一次成功完成偏差检测的时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss。

仅当资源栈组做过偏差检测，才会返回该参数

RdFolderId.description_en:
The ID of the folder in the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only for stack groups that use the service-managed permissions mode
RdFolderId.description_zh:
资源目录的资源夹ID。

仅限使用服务管理权限模式的资源栈组，才会返回该参数

RegionId.description_en: The region to which the stack belongs

StackDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the stack instance after the last successful drift detection.

Valid values:

DRIFTED: The stack instance has drifted.

NOT_CHECKED: No successful drift detection has been performed on the stack instance.

IN_SYNC: The stack instance is in sync.

This parameter is returned only when drift detection has been performed on the stack group
StackDriftStatus.description_zh:
最近一次成功完成偏差检测的资源栈的状态。

取值：
DRIFTED：资源栈处于偏差状态。
NOT_CHECKED：资源栈未进行过成功的偏差检测。
IN_SYNC：资源栈处于同步状态。

仅当资源栈组做过偏差检测，才会返回该参数

StackGroupId.description_en: The ID of the stack group

StackGroupName.description_en: The name of the stack group

StackId.description_en:
The ID of the stack.

This parameter is returned only when the status of the stack instance is CURRENT
StackId.description_zh:
资源栈所对应的资源栈ID。

仅当资源栈状态为CURRENT时，才会返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the stack instance.

Valid values:

CURRENT: The stack instance is up to date.

OUTDATED: The stack instance is not up to date with the stack group. This may occur due to the following reasons:
    - The stack instance failed to be created during the CreateStackInstances operation.
    - The stack instance failed to be updated or was only partially updated during the UpdateStackInstances or UpdateStackGroup operation.
    - The create or update operation is not completed
Status.description_zh:
资源栈的状态。

取值：

CURRENT：资源栈是最新的。

OUTDATED：资源栈不是资源栈组最新的。可能存在如下原因：
    - 在创建资源栈（CreateStackInstances）操作期间，创建对应的资源栈失败。
    - 在更新资源栈（UpdateStackInstances或UpdateStackGroup）操作期间，更新对应的资源栈失败，或只更新了部分资源栈。
    - 创建或更新操作未完成

StatusReason.description_en:
The reason for instance status.

This parameter is returned only when instance status of the stack instance is OUTDATED
StatusReason.description_zh:
状态原因描述。

仅当资源栈的实例状态为OUTDATED时，才会返回该参数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of stack instances
